decisions.decision: Follow the moved brief into README and the three guard-test path literals; leave spec planning records as written
decisions.why: The README is a live index and the guard tests fail rather than degrade when the path is stale; planning records are history that one line in the moved brief already explains
decisions.rejected: Updating all twenty-odd citations, or leaving a stub at the old path

decisions.decision: Correct only live guidance, current indexes and living records
decisions.why: A defect record states what was true when it was written, so a path that no longer resolves is part of the record
decisions.rejected: Correcting every hit a repository-wide search returns

decisions.decision: Leave the drift ledger's method prose naming three retired helpers, and record the gap in Non-goals
decisions.why: The approved remediation covers its dead file references; rewriting the mechanism section would describe a mechanism that no longer exists
decisions.rejected: Rewriting the method section or deleting the ledger

decisions.decision: Repair eight image links, not twelve
decisions.why: The before and after images live under pngs/ while the comparison images sit beside the proposal and already resolve, measured on disk
decisions.rejected: Prefixing all twelve, which breaks the four working links

decisions.decision: State each removal in one plain sentence and keep the remaining rows and columns
decisions.why: A reader who remembers a removed workflow learns what happened while a new reader is not sent to a dead link
decisions.rejected: Silently deleting the rows, or keeping rows whose links point nowhere

decisions.decision: Corrected four citations the audit had not reported: the Copilot integration script path, the title-bar helper path, the settings view-model path in AGENTS.md, and left the two already-marked-retired references alone
decisions.why: The success criterion asks that every path-like citation in always-applied guidance resolve; these were the only four that did not
decisions.rejected: Recording them as out-of-scope residue while the criterion claimed one hundred percent

decisions.decision: Recorded the generated PDF, the memory note and the diagrams manifest as residue instead of fixing them
decisions.why: Each needs either a build-output regeneration or a decision about machinery the approved scope excluded
decisions.rejected: Opening the scope to tooling and generated artifacts inside this feature

decisions.decision: Marked the ledger's retired helpers as retired with a note rather than deleting the sentences
decisions.why: The ledger's own rule says a retired artefact needs a note saying it is gone and why, so the next reader stops looking
decisions.rejected: Deleting the run instructions, which would lose the record of how the drift was computed
